properties.name: Adds the materialization guard: the tool now diffs what it wrote against its source and names every (node_type, property) the round trip invented, because it CANNOT undo the injection - after the round trip nothing tells an injected value from a chosen one. THE DESIGN ALREADY SAID THIS (fact:bl-198); only the tool was wrong, hence design_holds. See chg:the-export-round-trip-injected-defaults.
